name: rosetta-babbage-problem
code:
use IO.Std.write_line

let smallest =
    for candidate in 1::100000 do
        if candidate * candidate % 1000000 == 269696 then
            break candidate
        fi
    od!

let babbage = 99736L

write_line("smallest: {smallest} squared is {smallest * smallest}")
write_line("Babbage's: {babbage} squared is {babbage * babbage}")
write_line("both end in 269696, so Babbage's answer was not the smallest")
